scope: Presentation-layer failure modes only; no authority-layer semantic edits

tests.failure_mode: A0 media size silently falls back to six Letter pages, destroying the two-board contract.
tests.resolution: The generation source now uses an explicit A0 landscape page box and asserts two pages per language.

tests.failure_mode: System-font fallback changes line breaks or removes Chinese glyphs on another host.
tests.resolution: A reproducible Noto Sans SC subset is built from a source with a locked SHA-256; all PDF fonts are embedded, subset, and ToUnicode-enabled.

tests.failure_mode: A shared cover communicates the rights boundary in only one language.
tests.resolution: The deterministic cover and its PDF caption carry the same Chinese and English conceptual-use and prohibited-use statement.

tests.failure_mode: A mobile reader can open a dense figure but cannot pan or reach the evidence at a legible scale.
tests.resolution: All eleven figures open in a scrollable modal with 100/150/200 percent controls and keyboard focus management.

tests.failure_mode: Zoom is visual-only: keyboard users cannot operate it or return to their triggering figure.
tests.resolution: The dialog traps focus, supports Escape/close, restores focus, and exposes semantic title and summary text.

tests.failure_mode: Seven wide report tables become unreachable clipping zones at narrow widths.
tests.resolution: Every table wrapper is a labelled, focusable horizontal-scroll region with a visible focus treatment and non-color cue.

tests.failure_mode: The Visual evidence drawer leaves background controls focusable or loses the return point.
tests.resolution: Opening the drawer makes peers inert, traps focus, supports Escape, and restores focus to the trigger.

tests.failure_mode: F08 and F11 use native selectable text but remain Figure-grouped in tagged PDF, so a screen reader cannot navigate them cell by cell as semantic tables.
tests.resolution: Retain Figure+Alt, native selectable text, and same-page summaries in PDF; direct readers to the accessible HTML summaries and machine-readable matrices for detailed navigation.

tests.failure_mode: A decorative figure wrapper around the cover creates an unnamed duplicate Figure in the PDF structure tree.
tests.resolution: The cover wrapper is a section; final structure counts match Figure and Alt exactly: 12/12 in A3 and 7/7 in A0.

tests.failure_mode: A0 governance conclusions are technically present but too small to support far/mid/near reading.
tests.resolution: Board headlines, primary panels, and direct-result bands use separate tiers; core direct summaries are at least 18pt and the document-wide metadata target is 14pt.

tests.failure_mode: A0 uses a strip of illegible figure thumbnails as evidence theatre.
tests.resolution: The support strip is a four-card judgement index for F06/F07/F09/F10, while full figures remain in A3/HTML.

tests.failure_mode: F08/F11 remain dense enough that a projection or casual screen view cannot expose every row.
tests.resolution: Native PDF summaries expose all twelve scenarios, authority, Human Takeover, exit, SC10+IM06 only, thirteen retained negative outcomes, and unknowns; original-image dialogs and structured sources remain the detail path.

tests.failure_mode: An operator projects the A0 PDF as if it were a presentation and the audience cannot read it.
tests.resolution: Use the responsive Visual or the sequential A3 route for projection; reserve A0 for large-format far/mid/near viewing.

tests.failure_mode: A reader lands on F08 or F11 without knowing its place in the 30-second or 3-minute route.
tests.resolution: A3 pages use route breadcrumbs, stable F identifiers, A3 page numbers, and next-stage references.

tests.failure_mode: The exit page foregrounds lifecycle graphics while hiding the six unknown metrics, twelve controller unknowns, and incomplete authorizations.
tests.resolution: F11 and A0 Board 2 place retained negative outcomes and unknown/incomplete boundaries in direct summary bands at normal view.

tests.failure_mode: The inner frozen F-figure page counter can be mistaken for the outer A3 document page counter.
tests.resolution: The presentation shell labels its counter explicitly as A3 PAGE and the inner number remains part of the frozen F-figure caption layer.

tests.failure_mode: Only F08/F11 can be enlarged, creating an inconsistent keyboard and evidence path across F01-F11.
tests.resolution: All four HTML outputs expose the same eleven figure identifiers, captions, alternative texts, semantic summaries, and zoom controls from one registry.

retained_boundaries: No geometry, metric, source, governance, protocol, red-team authority, or numbering family was changed to close a display finding.
Negative, zero, provisional, and unknown results remain visible.
The PDFs are independently structure-checked tagged PDFs, not asserted PDF/UA documents.
